tags.name: Pasang Lhamu Highway
tags.note: No previous smoothness tag. Only small vehicles (4 x 4 jeeps) are allowed. Caution due to risk of landslides. Not advised to travel the route at night. Relief vehicles should register with the police in Kalikasthan before driving to Dhunche.
